Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6) • Install: Hospital

Advanced hydraulics and springs in the user’s wrists and forearms can drastically reduce perceived heft in combat. Take a load off.

Iconic Cyberarm Option. Requires Shock Absorber and 1 Cyberarm Option Slot. The usual bonus provided by Shock Absorber to Autofire Checks is increased by 1 (+2 Total), and when the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) during an Autofire Check, they do not roll an implosion d10. All other effects or results of the Critical Failure still occur.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Change the Shock Absorber's effect to +2 while this is installed.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
